# … 啩 · *… gwaa3*

**Meaning:** I suppose; probably · **Level:** B1 · **Topic:** Sentence-final particles

> **Draft: awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [report it](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new?template=content-error.yml&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20grammar%2Fgwaa3-suppose).

啩 at the end of a sentence makes it a guess: "I think", "probably". It often goes with 應該 (should). 唔係啩 means "surely not".

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **聽日會落雨啩。** |
| Jyutping | ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5 gwaa3. |
| Yale | tīng yaht wúih lohk yúh gwa. |
| Bopomofo | ㄊㄧㄥ¹ ㄧㄜㆵ⁶ ㄨㄨㄧ⁵ ㄌㄛㆶ⁶ ㄩ⁵ ㄍㄨㄚ³. |
| English | It'll rain tomorrow, I think. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **佢應該到咗啩。** |
| Jyutping | keoi5 jing1 goi1 dou3 zo2 gwaa3. |
| Yale | kéuih yīng gōi dou jó gwa. |
| Bopomofo | ㄎㆤㄧ⁵ ㄧㄥ¹ ㄍㄛㄧ¹ ㄉㄛㄨ³ ㄗㄛ² ㄍㄨㄚ³. |
| English | He should be there by now, I suppose. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **唔係啩！** |
| Jyutping | m4 hai6 gwaa3! |
| Yale | m̀h haih gwa! |
| Bopomofo | ㆬ⁴ ㄏㄜㄧ⁶ ㄍㄨㄚ³! |
| English | Surely not! |
